cases.req: REF3030E sourcing the ladder directly (B, no buffer), plus the ADS124S08's REFP0 (18 uA): output current, headroom, load regulation, self-heating; every element at -tol
cases.limit: I <= 10 mA (the load-regulation range) and VIN - VOUT >= 0.2 V
cases.worst: 2.12 mA (2.08 nominal); headroom 210 mV at +3.3 V_A = 3.210 V; load regulation <= 96 uV (specified at VIN = VOUT + 0.5 V *(check)*); self-heating 0.18 K = 2.7 ppm
cases.note: ratiometric for the ADS124S08 (REFP0 is the ladder's top node); a static term of PA-6 for the Due's gain fit, which uses the top tap's absolute value; element dissipation 1.18 mW of 100.0 mW rating

cases.req: B: the Due's sample-and-hold kick on the top tap (= the REF3030E output = REFP0), sampled from 0 V, into the 2 x 100 nF at -10 %
cases.limit: <= 0.5 LSB at the Due (C1-b); no Due tap read while the ADS124S08 converts
cases.worst: 18 pC -> 0.100 mV = 0.12 LSB before the REF3030E recovers it (its output impedance at MHz is not modelled)
cases.note: sequencing rule (B): the Due does not read the ladder while the ADS124S08 converts; calibration already reads them one after the other (C4-c)

cases.req: PA-9 Due-ADC gain/offset fit from the MCP-read taps, error that the ladder + MCP readback add (6 taps: CH2-CH6 + the buffered top tap on CH7, so the OPA365's offset is pure scale; 8 x 270 ohm 1 % (3 parallel + 5 series), buffer offset 200 uV, ADS124S08 read: INL 10 ppm FSR max, 1.2 uVrms, input current 1 nA/V), at the span ends 0.2 V / 3.1 V

cases.note: top tap through REFIN+ instead (previous): 0.089 LSB; buffer offset 0: 0.098 LSB

cases.req: PA-9 fit robustness: one of the 6 taps dropped (5 left), ladder + MCP error
SC-10 leakage: Due ADC pin leakage 0.5 uA max (Table 45-38) x tap impedance, added to C2-a

cases.req: PA-9 taps re-read by the MCP at every calibration: elements drift +-0.10 % (100 ppm/K x 10 K, uncorrelated) after an earlier read; the calibration re-reads them
cases.worst: 0.098 LSB re-read; 0.826 LSB if the earlier reading is reused (stale)
cases.note: with 10 ppm/K parts even the stale reading passes, so the re-read rule is margin here rather than load-bearing; the guard runs the stale arm at 200 ppm/K
